title: Football analysis is for coders. Not anymore.

beats.title: The myth
beats.onScreen: FOOTBALL ANALYSIS IS FOR CODERS. over the finished chart: Di María's goal and the three passes before it.
beats.motion: Headline is up from frame 0. A red pen stroke strikes out "is for coders" (frames 11–17); the headline jolts and the struck words dim.
beats.sound: Swipe as the pen moves, thump as it lands.

beats.title: The flip
beats.onScreen: NOT ANYMORE. in green under the struck-out line.
beats.motion: NOT ANYMORE. pops in from 60%. The chart behind slowly pushes in on the goal.

beats.title: 1 · Just ask
beats.onScreen: A chat bubble: the real prompt, asking for the three passes, who and when, and his shirt number, on StatsBomb's free data.
beats.motion: The prompt types in over about 3 seconds. Then the Claude spark spins beside "Claude is writing the chart…".
beats.sound: A soft tick per word, a pop as Claude starts.

beats.title: 2 · Claude writes it
beats.onScreen: The component Claude wrote, as written, in a code window. Four callouts: free StatsBomb data, the last 3 passes, the goal angle, who passed and when.
beats.motion: Code streams in, then the window scrolls to each callout line in turn and lights it. Then "PitchKit's agent skill teaches Claude the library".
beats.sound: Whoosh, then a pop per callout.

beats.title: 3 · You get this: the passes
beats.onScreen: Reel 05's striped pitch. Messi → Álvarez → Mac Allister, each labelled with the passer and the time. Di María's 11 as he receives.
beats.motion: Each pass draws on while the camera follows it; its label pops in, and the name chain below grows as each pass lands.
beats.sound: A swipe per pass, a tick as each lands.

beats.title: The goal
beats.onScreen: Di María's shot and his goal angle; the whole move; MESSI → ÁLVAREZ → MAC ALLISTER → DI MARÍA, with Di María in green.
beats.motion: The shot and the goal angle grow from the shooter towards goal, then the camera pulls back to the whole move.

beats.title: The payoff
beats.onScreen: YOU DON'T WRITE THE CODE. JUST ASK. The install command, then "Save this. Then try it ↓".
beats.motion: Each line springs up in turn.
beats.sound: Whoosh, then a tick per line.
